scope: Two native Qt clients, seeded 40-message pure-text group; runtime business only Qt A/C with S005 observer. Initial bottom, own/peer sends, older-reader contrast, multiline composer.
measurement_rule: Entire message-row rectangle contained by viewport (all four edges). Partial intersection is never a PASS. Text is read from AT-SPI visible row objects, not hidden model snapshots.
limitations: Qt 6.2 AT-SPI DESKTOP extents were logical at non-unit DPR. Driver mapped them using independently measured native xwininfo frame geometry; this is not a claim of general AT-SPI DPI correctness.
Exposed scrollbars were hidden zero-sized 0..0 controls, not usable message-scroll value/max. Visibility and older-reader stability use row geometry/text and native event trace.
Frozen baseline SHA has prior stage45/46 provenance in docs/experience-quality.md and qt-auth-feedback-proof.json. At-run candidate source pins do NOT identify baseline compiled source.
Only five source inputs were guarded in these native runs; retained driver hash is a current readback, not an independently recorded at-run hash.
Narrow follow-bottom native evidence is not the whole DPI/IME/a11y matrix, the ten-phase daily flow, or completion of the >=92 experience goal.
Only selected original screenshots and compact records are retained. Temporary raw scopes are removed after terminal/process/database checks; hashes do not substitute for deleted full logs.
